author: HJPLUS
tagline_en: Log a set one-handed at the gym; let the agent coach you
description_en: Log strength training (weight × reps, per set) and meals (calories and macros) — built-in exercise library, routine templates, training-volume and 1RM stats, plus InBody reports captured by photo and filled in automatically.
features_en: Mobile-first: one tap and zero typing to log a set ("repeat last set" copies the previous one) — done inside a 60-second rest
48 built-in exercises covering all six muscle groups; save multiple routine templates and apply one to any date in a tap

Photograph an InBody report and the numbers fill themselves in — assessments accumulate like a medical chart, so next time the AI compares against what it said before. Values only; the photo is never stored
Charts: training volume stacked by muscle group, plus body-weight and body-composition trends — switch between day / week / month
36 AI tools: log workouts by talking, review trends, and have the agent build routines and progressive overload from your actual history
Data lives in a local SQLite file; the plugin's server has no network capability and never touches your workspace files
